name: Minazuki Kirika
source: Popular martial artist and undefeated champion. Her life was full of challenges and gratifications until she is marked down by a disgusting pervert. As if fate was playing cruel trick on her, the evil bastard managed to grasp the only weakness of the almighty champion. The only way to save her sickly important childhood friend.
